items.title: Vault controls need authority distinct from ordinary case WRITE
items.observation: The vault's existing WRITE grant cannot safely imply scan, lawful-hold, retention, local-deletion or audit powers. A separate current transactional control callback is required and missing control denies.
items.product_implication: Under existing B03-02, integrate explicit least-privilege control authority with current B03-01 identity/session policy rather than exposing privileged controls through the local operator token.

history.reason: existing_task: implemented fail-closed separate control seam and negative tests; no production role matrix, owner approval or broad gate is implied.

items.title: A clean scan verdict is publishable only for its exact live attempt and vault revision
items.observation: Revocation, scan cancellation and hold/retention revision changes during scanning invalidate publication even when a scanner later reports clean. Interrupted scans must not automatically resume or repeat on command replay.
items.product_implication: Keep scan claim, processing and release separate; recheck current authority and exact attempt/revision at publication, require explicit cancellation/restart and state that cancellation cannot recall bytes already supplied to a scanner.

history.reason: existing_task: implemented revision-bound scan publication/cancel/restart/idempotency tests within B03-02; real scanner isolation and bounded adapter execution remain integration gates.

items.title: Local ciphertext deletion is not proof of storage-wide or legal erasure
items.observation: Deleting a local encrypted blob can preserve an immutable descriptor and audited tombstone while leaving derived text, WAL/filesystem remnants, backups, replicas and provider retention outside its scope. Without current dependency clearance the vault must deny deletion.
items.product_implication: Label deletion local_vault_ciphertext_only, enforce hold/retention plus same-transaction dependency guard and preserve independent erasure/recovery evidence as an existing B03-02 production gate.

history.reason: existing_task: implemented guarded local deletion and exact scope labeling/tests, not a compliance-erasure or managed-backup claim; broader production proof remains open.

items.title: Reviewed source handles are references, not future publication authority
items.observation: A source handle returned before projection publication can become stale, revoked or unavailable. The final source gate must run on the caller's same-database transaction and verify current scope, exact revision/hash, clean release and authenticated ciphertext, with audit rolled back alongside the mutation.
items.product_implication: Use Vault.require_source(db, identity=..., case_id=..., object_id=..., expected_revision=..., expected_sha256=...) immediately at final shared BEGIN IMMEDIATE commit/publish boundary; never authorize from a cached handle or separate connection.

history.reason: existing_task: added safe metadata-only transaction gate and rollback/staleness/revocation/quarantine/ciphertext tests for B03-02 integration; collaboration wrapper agreement and cumulative integration tests remain separate.

items.title: Content-envelope encryption and a local audit chain do not solve metadata custody
items.observation: AES-GCM protects original bytes and authenticates their descriptor, but filenames, scope metadata and audit identifiers remain outside the content envelope. SQLite triggers/hash chains do not protect against an administrator rewriting or truncating the database and chain.
items.product_implication: Require explicit whole-storage protection, key custody, independent audit anchoring and recovery threat review before any production claim; do not relabel the local wrapper/audit chain as managed infrastructure.

history.reason: existing_task: preserve B03-02 production security/custody/recovery gates. No external infrastructure or independent security decision was authorized; bounded local implementation states these limits rather than inventing evidence.

items.title: Uncertain vault command outcomes need an explicit refresh boundary
items.observation: The isolated panel separates immutable original version from mutable vault revision and clears visible object data/disables mutations after an uncertain command outcome. Disposal/generation guards reject late responses; no automatic retry is performed. These are implemented safeguards, not browser or operator-value evidence.
items.product_implication: Integrate the panel only with host-current agency auth and dispose on session/case change; measure correction burden and safe publication/deletion decisions after native and operator testing rather than treating screen or test counts as value.

history.reason: existing_task: implemented a focused explicit-control UI seam under B03-02 without shared navigation changes; native/accessibility/real operator evidence remains unaccepted.
